end

def minPath(grid, k)
  n = grid.length
  r, c = nil, nil
  k.times do
    if r.nil?
      r, c = 1, 0 # value 1 is at (1,0) in the second example; find it generally:
      grid.each_with_index { |row, i| row.each_with_index { |v, j| r, c = i, j if v == 1 } }
    end

    best_r, best_c = r, c
    [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]].each do |dr, dc|
      nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
      if nr.between?(0, n - 1) && nc.between?(0, n - 1) && grid[nr][nc] < grid[best_r][best_c]
        best_r, best_c = nr, nc
      end
    end

    path << grid[r][c]
    r, c = best_r, best_c
  end
  path
end

  end
